title: Unit- and Site-Level Environmental Transfer Boundaries
scientific_scope: All frozen unit-level, site-level, symptom-linked, and quantitative-assay observations within the selected environmental sampling boundary.
analysis_unit: One sampled unit with its sites and study days; sites from the same unit are repeated observations rather than independent units.
missingness: No curator-imposed row deletion, random subsampling, or imputation is applied within the frozen task boundary.
license_boundary: The selected observations are from a CC BY article record and are bundled after unit and site identity removal.
warnings: The observational data cannot by themselves prove a transmission route or direction.
Unit-level blocking is required to avoid treating many sampled sites as independent subjects.
source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
